data.title: This Is Not Blue
data.synopsis: An experimental film by mareykrap about the color blue. Blue pigment in the natural world is very rare. Instead, what we typically observe is the reflection of blue light waves. How much "true blue" really exists in our world? A series of blue images. Or are they?

data.title: Dahua Zhi Shaonian You
data.synopsis:
Rookie Jianghu and swordsman Xiao Yao Sheng have defeated the baby-eater that caused Chang'an, but they now find themselves falling into a bigger mystery. They traveled to the distant Spirit Beast Village and met the beautiful Demon Fox Girl, the Bone Elves, and people of all kinds inhabiting rivers and lakes along the way. They gained growth and friendship, but are now entangled in a greater crisis: a dispute between immortals and demons. The animation will combine elements such as martial arts, fantasy, blood, adventure, and more, to present to the audience a tale of ups and downs in legendary stories!

(Source: V2Anime)

data.title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland CMs
data.title_japanese: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド TVCM
data.synopsis:
The distinguished Night Raven College, an all-boys arcane academy, houses its students in dormitories modeled after the historical figures known as the Great Seven. These dorms—Heartslabyul, Savanaclaw, Octavinelle, Scarabia, Pomefiore, Ignihyde, and Diasomnia—are like worlds of their own, each governed by a housewarden who holds near absolute authority. But individuals with power often hide the most severe traumas, and eventually, even those suppressed emotions must overflow.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
data.background: Disney: Twisted-Wonderland CMs are animated commercials for the 2020 mobile game Disney: Twisted-Wonderland which aired on TV and were posted on the official YouTube channel. The animation is unique and is not present in the game nor in the TV series.

data.title: Wish You Luck
data.synopsis:
Animated music video for Peaky P-key's song Wish You Luck. The track is apart of their first single release "Peak Peaky&Peaky!!" and was also used as an insert song in the final episode of the D4DJ First Mix anime.

This music video initially released on the official D4DJ Channel's YouTube, but was re-uploaded again with a CM recut on October 23, 2020. It was later published standalone also through D4DJ's Global Channel on January 6, 2021.

(Source: AniList)
